summary: All five phases delivered their stated objectives and all commit subjects match the plan exactly. Deviations in phases 01, 03, 04, and 05 are fully documented and justified in their respective handoffs. Phase-02 is the primary concern: the planned generator edit target (apps/le-secretaire-de-fernand/src/build/modules/seo/content-index.ts) was never touched, the generator was re-homed to different modules, and the phase-handoff.md is missing — leaving all file-plan deviations unjustified by record. Despite this, the artifact is produced and consumed correctly by later phases, so the objective is met. Two minor gaps exist: phase-02 handoff absent, and phase-05 does not include an explicit test asserting that SeriesNavCta composes with renderAfterContent without dropping the reader-feedback surface.

attentionPoints: Phase-02 handoff (phase-handoff.md) is missing. The planned generator edit target apps/le-secretaire-de-fernand/src/build/modules/seo/content-index.ts was never touched; the generator was re-homed to packages/louloupress/src/modules/content/build/generated-indexes/content-indexing.ts and apps/le-secretaire-de-fernand/src/build/modules/content/indexing/content-indexing.ts. Human review is recommended to confirm the generator is correctly integrated and invocable via the content:indexes:generate script.

Phase-05 test does not assert that SeriesNavCta composes with renderAfterContent without dropping the ReaderFeedbackController surface. The plan specified this scenario. The implementation is structurally correct (null-return pattern), but no explicit regression test exists.
All five commit subjects match the plan exactly — no concern here.

Runtime: all series resolvers return null until series.json is populated with editorial data. Series pages 404 and in-article navigation is inert. This is expected and documented across multiple handoffs.
pointers: Possible scope question in phase-02: the generator was split between a louloupress package module and an app-level module rather than extending the planned content-index.ts. Confirm via code review that the integration path from content:indexes:generate to series-usage.json emission is complete and does not skip any planned validation step.
